justification: Adds a rendered provenance line to the PAID conveyancing PDF's DCP section and changes the brief's DCP as_at semantics on a served surface. Also writes to production (new dcp_plan_as_at table, additive effective_date_basis column, 23 populated rows). Wrong wording or a wrongly-attached date here is a false representation inside the legal defence layer (Layer 2), the class disclaimers don't cure.

falsifiable_check.passes_when: 49 pins green: authority order portal>stated>observed holds with two refusals — a portal/stated CONFLICT renders no date, and observed_current exists only when EVERY active registry chapter was checked (oldest check date, MIN not MAX); a month-precision date renders without a day; a bare year label never parses to a date; an identity-mismatched portal plan attaches no date; an as-at lookup failure leaves the controls serving with as_at None; the brief's DCP DataFields carry the plan date or None, never date.today(); the extractor serves the LATEST effective statement and reads amendment tables as approved/in-force PAIRS. The coverage check reports dateless_claims (baseline 292 of 954, 10 LGAs, after the honesty-tightening) in observation mode; zero served claims is an inability to measure (exit 2), never a satisfied target. The as-at is a typed three-state: resolved / absent / unavailable — a failed lookup renders a visible could-not-be-retrieved disclosure, and the observed wording claims only the URL-check fact, never 'current version'.
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any pin regressing: swapping the authority order fails test_portal_wins_when_stated_absent/test_stated_beats_observed; silently picking a side of a portal/stated conflict fails test_conflicting_portal_and_stated_render_nothing; ignoring precision fails test_month_precision_never_renders_a_day; re-enabling label parsing fails test_bare_year_is_never_a_date; attaching a date across the Hornsby-class identity mismatch fails test_identity_mismatch_is_a_finding_not_a_pick; letting the as-at query raise through fails test_as_at_failure_does_not_kill_controls; restoring as_at=date.today() fails test_brief_dcp_fields_carry_no_date_when_none_defensible; first-statement-wins fails test_latest_effective_statement_wins; a page-wide amendment-table maximum fails test_amendment_table_ignores_approved_only_dates. collapsing failure into absence fails test_as_at_failure_does_not_kill_controls_and_is_disclosed (asserts the disclosure AND that conn.rollback was never called); a planName/planURL date conflict attaching fails test_name_url_date_conflict_refuses; 'current' reappearing in the observed wording fails test_observed_wording_claims_only_the_stored_fact; check_dcp_as_at_coverage exits 2 when it cannot measure, including on a zero-claim census.
falsifiable_check.demonstrated_failing: The pre-change states these pins encode were observed live this session: the PDF DCP section rendered no date of any kind (generate_conveyancing_report.py:4814 pre-change); intelligence_brief.py:2776-2779 stamped as_at=date.today() on every DCP field; the first fetcher dry-run attached 2022-09-09 to leichhardt via a sole-result pick that the identity guard now refuses (portal lists only the Ashfield comprehensive plan for Inner West parcels); migration 040's parser manufactured 528 YYYY-01-01 dates from version labels (DQ-41).
falsifiable_check.mutation_evidence: return None from _plan_as_at unconditionally -> the three authority-order pins fail. Drop the conflict refusal -> test_conflicting_portal_and_stated_render_nothing fails. Render day for month precision -> the never-renders-a-day pin fails. Drop the len(row)!=7 guard -> test_wrong_arity_row_is_none fails. Replace the wording with 'verified as at' -> test_language_ladder_no_banned_words fails. Make pick_dcp_result return dcp_results[0] -> the Sydney superset pin and the Hornsby identity pin both fail. Revert scan_statement to first-wins -> test_latest_effective_statement_wins fails. Revert scan_amendment_table to page-wide max -> test_amendment_table_ignores_approved_only_dates fails.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls (1071 rows: effective_date 893 populated, all label-derived, no basis - measured before design); dcp_chapter_registry.url_last_checked (523/564 active); lot_search_index (3.13M rows, lga_name/former_council/geom, no propId); documents table precedent for amendment_date naming. Full backup dcp_setback_controls_backup_20260803_item3 (1071 rows asserted) before the ALTER.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Registry council slugs match dcp_setback_controls.lga for all geographic slugs (verified); nsw_statewide has no registry council so it can never get an observed date - it is in the dateless baseline by design, not accident. lot_search_index lga_name needed 5 explicit overrides (CANTERBURY-BANKSTOWN, SYDNEY, KU-RING-GAI, CITY OF PARRAMATTA, THE HILLS SHIRE) - verified against live values, coded as a dict.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All schema changes additive: new table + one nullable column. Every pre-existing effective_date row keeps effective_date_basis NULL and is treated as unattributed - never rendered (DQ-41). Serve-path dict gains as_at/as_at_line keys; absent keys degrade to no line for any stale caller.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Portal /dcp failure, no-propId, or lgaName echo mismatch -> row NOT written (source unavailable is never 'checked, none found'); serve-time as-at lookup failure -> controls still serve, as_at None, warning logged; check script exits 2 when it cannot measure.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend type change required: conveyancing JSON passes the dict through; the brief's DataField.as_at was already Optional[str] and provenance.ts already renders asAt only when present (skips undefined).
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Worst case on failure: the DCP section carries no as-at line (visible absence, counted 193-at-baseline by the observation check) - never a wrong date, never a manufactured precision, never the generation date dressed as currency.

functions.name: _plan_as_at
functions.input: an open DB cursor plus the serving lga slug string from fetch_dcp_setbacks
functions.output: dict{date, precision, kind, basis} in authority order portal>stated>observed, or None to the serve-path dict
functions.if_none: no row / all-null / wrong-arity row -> None; caller renders no date line

functions.name: format_as_at_line
functions.input: the as_at dict produced by _plan_as_at, or None when nothing was defensible
functions.output: one basis-appropriate sentence string for every rendering surface (PDF, JSON, brief), or None
functions.if_none: None in -> None out; unknown basis or unparseable date -> None, never a guessed sentence

functions.name: parse_dated_phrase
functions.input: the official planName string or URL-decoded planURL text from the portal /dcp response
functions.output: (iso_date, precision, kind, verbatim substring) parsed from explicit dated phrases only, back to fetch_one
functions.if_none: bare-year labels and invalid dates return None - the retired version-parser class stays dead

functions.name: pick_dcp_result
functions.input: the registry dcp_name identity list for the slug plus the portal dcpResults entry list
functions.output: (chosen_entry, None) or (None, failure_reason) - identity-anchored, exact token sets beat supersets, singleton-date rule for multi-volume plans
functions.if_none: empty results / identity mismatch / ambiguity -> (None, reason); nothing written

functions.name: scan_statement
functions.input: the absolute path plus relative name of one mapped local plan PDF in data/dcps
functions.output: a Stated record (iso date, day precision, kind, verbatim line with file and page) for the upsert
functions.if_none: pattern no longer matches -> SKIPPED and reported, never guessed

functions.name: _build_dcp_controls
functions.input: the fetch_dcp_setbacks result dict including the new plan-level as_at key, plus the lga slug
functions.output: DCPControls whose four DataField.as_at values carry the plan date string or None, never date.today()
functions.if_none: as_at absent -> None on all four fields; provenance UI shows no date (was: date.today())

values.if_missing: no line renders - visible absence, counted by the observation check

values.guard_at: scripts/conveyancing_db.py:236 (len(row) != 7 -> None) and :296-306 (nested try keeps controls serving)

queries.where_clause: registry: council = %s AND is_active = TRUE (MAX url_last_checked); LEFT JOIN dcp_plan_as_at ON lga = %s
queries.if_zero: obs-subquery row always exists; all-null -> as_at None, no line
queries.if_wrong: wrong-LGA row impossible via equality on the serving slug; wrong basis order pinned by tests

queries.purpose: served-claim census in the check script
queries.where_clause: is_current = TRUE AND (needs_review IS NULL OR needs_review = FALSE) - the same filters fetch_dcp_setbacks serves under
queries.if_zero: empty census -> 0 claims reported; exit still 0 (an honest empty)
queries.if_wrong: looser filters would overcount dateless claims (conservative direction)

queries.where_clause: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (lga) DO UPDATE - single-row, keyed by slug
queries.if_zero: written count compared to predicted count; mismatch exits 2
queries.if_wrong: CHECK constraints refuse a date without precision/kind/evidence
